lines.original: Look in thy glass and tell the face thou viewest,
lines.english: Look in the mirror and tell the face that you see in it,
lines.translation: Aynaya bak ve söyle o surata,

lines.original: Now is the time that face should form another,
lines.english: That now is the time that your face show make another,
lines.translation: Artık geldi sıra kendinden bir tane daha yaratmaya.

lines.original: Whose fresh repair if now thou not renewest,
lines.english: If you do not renew your beauty by passing it on,

lines.original: Thou dost beguile the world, unbless some mother.
lines.english: You cheat the world, and unbless some mother.
lines.translation: İhanet dünyaya ve lanettir bir anaya.

lines.original: For where is she so fair whose uneared womb
lines.english: There is no woman whose unused womb
lines.translation: Nerede vardır bir kadın öylesine güzel ki, bakir rahmi,

lines.original: Disdains the tillage of thy husbandry?
lines.english: Would refuse your husbandry of her?

lines.original: Or who is he so fond will be the tomb
lines.english: And who is so foolish that he will make a tomb
lines.translation: Ya da sen mi safsın öldürecek kadar,

lines.original: Of his self-love, to stop posterity?
lines.english: Out of his self-love, to stop himself having heirs.

lines.original: Thou art thy mother’s glass, and she in thee
lines.english: You are the mirror image of your mother, and you
lines.translation: Yansımasısın annenin, ve onun gençliği hala,

lines.original: Calls back the lovely April of her prime;
lines.english: Recall the lovely spring-time of her youth.

lines.original: So thou through windows of thine age shalt see,
lines.english: Similarly, you will be able to see with your own eyes,
lines.translation: İşte sen de ne kadar yaşlansan de bakabileceksin,

lines.original: Despite of wrinkles, this thy golden time.
lines.english: Despite your old age, this golden time of your youth.
lines.translation: Her ne kadar kırışsan da, gençliğinin altın zamanlarına.

lines.original: But if thou live remembered not to be,
lines.english: But if you live as if you don't want to be remembered,
lines.translation: Ama dersen ki benim gönlüm yok bu dünyada hatırlanmaya,

lines.original: Die single and thine image dies with thee.
lines.english: You die single and your image will die with you.
lines.translation: Öl yalnız başına ve karışsın ruhun da seninle birlikte toprağa.
